schools.lore: One of the Empire's oldest bushi styles, forged against the Shadowlands: endure the enemy's blows, then crush them with heavy weapons.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Heavy Weapons (Tetsubo), Intimidation, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Ignore TN penalties for wearing heavy armor (except for Stealth), and gain +1k0 to the total of all damage rolls with a Heavy Weapon.

schools.lore: Students of Kobo Ichi-Kai, taught at Clear Water Village, who put unarmed fighting above every other kind. Their strength makes them fine yojimbo and a match even for Shadowlands creatures.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu (Improvised Weapons) 2, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 to resist Intimidation/Fear, and +1k0 to unarmed or improvised-weapon attack and damage rolls — but you must always keep high dice on those boosted rolls.
ask: From Emerald Empire p.247: check your GM uses this book.
know: Starts with low Honor (2.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Where the Hida endure, the Hiruma evade, striking weak points with lightning speed. Their School is built for movement and survival inside the Shadowlands.
schools.sk: Athletics, Hunting, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth, any one Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 to attack rolls while in the Attack Stance, and double the duration food/water/jade rations last for a number of people equal to your Hunting Rank.

schools.lore: The Empire's foremost builders, siege engineers and armourers, devoted to the Crab's defence against the Shadowlands. Many also lead troops, turning siegecraft to war.
schools.sk: Battle, Craft: Armorsmithing, Craft: Weaponsmithing, Defense, Engineering, Lore: Architecture, War Fan
schools.t1d: +1k0 on any School Skill Roll; spending a Void Point on a School Skill Roll grants +2k2 instead of +1k1 (the two bonuses don't stack).
ask: From The Great Clans p.39: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Thought of as obsessive madmen who delve into forbidden secrets, the Kuni accept that as the price of fighting the Shadowlands. Their alliance with the Nezumi gives them insight into other nonhumans.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), Defense, Lore: Shadowlands 2, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one Weapon Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 on Spell Casting Rolls against non-human creatures; damage spells deal +1k1 against Tainted targets, and gain a Free Raise on any Jade-keyword spell.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.
Starts with low Honor (2.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: A small band of mystic warriors who roam the Empire hunting maho-tsukai and Shadowlands infiltrators, ignoring borders. Commoners welcome them; other samurai often do not.
schools.sk: Investigation, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Lore: Maho, Meditation, any one Skill
schools.t1d: Sense Taint in a target via a Contested Roll (Investigation/Awareness vs. Sincerity/Willpower), gaining +1k0 per full Rank of their Taint; also +1k1 to resist Taint and to attacks against Shadowlands creatures or known Tainted foes.
ask: From The Great Clans p.40: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Specialists in destroying creatures from other spirit realms, with a fluid style for unexpected monsters: potent against the otherworldly, less so against people.
schools.sk: Animal Handling (Falcons), Hunting 2, Kenjutsu, Etiquette, Lore: Spirit Realms, Spears, any one Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 on Perception-based Skill and Trait rolls, and +1k0 to damage against creatures from other Spirit Realms.

schools.lore: Once Crane, the Yasuki joined the Crab and became the Empire's richest merchants. Their courtiers are salesmen who find what a rival needs and supply it, at a price.
schools.sk: Commerce (Appraisal), Courtier, Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation, Sincerity (Deceit), any one Merchant Skill
schools.t1d: Free Raise on Commerce with no Honor/Glory loss for using it publicly; Contested Roll (Commerce/Perception vs. Etiquette/Awareness) to discern what someone wants.
know: Starts with low Honor (2.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: After Hiruma Castle fell, the family lost the teachers of its old bushi School. The Hiruma Scouts are the stealthy style practised in that era.
schools.sk: Athletics, Hunting, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth (Sneaking), any one Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Unless surprised or otherwise unaware, add Stealth Rank to Initiative. Food, water and jade rations last twice as long for a number of people equal to Hunting Rank. In the Shadowlands, gain +1k0 to Stealth and always know the direction and approximate distance to the Empire. (Imperial Histories 1 p.147 (no outfit specified))
ask: From Imperial Histories 1 p.147: check your GM uses this book.
Belongs to one period of Rokugan's history: check it fits your campaign's era.

schools.lore: Part priests and part monks, the Asahina value preserving life over destruction, treat every ritual as a lesson and prize the making of art. Their magic leans towards protection.
schools.sk: any one Artisan Skill, Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High Skill
schools.t1d: Spend a Void Point to reduce all opponents' damage rolls within 20' by 0k1 for a number of Rounds equal to School Rank (re-triggering resets but doesn't stack the duration); Free Raise on Defense-keyword spells.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: The Crane's quiet strength: heavy infantry and yojimbo who win the day when words fail, with Techniques for enduring blows and guarding others.
schools.sk: Battle, Defense 2, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, any one Skill
schools.t1d: Gain bonus Wounds per Wound Rank equal to (Honor Rank rounded down, minus 4, minimum 1); +1k0 to attack rolls in the Attack Stance.

schools.lore: A Daidoji style of scouting, ambush and precise strikes at commanders and supply lines. Its scouts use traps and surprise, accepting some dishonour for the good of the Crane.
schools.sk: Athletics, Hunting (Traps), Kenjutsu, Knives, Kyujutsu (Yumi), Stealth (Sneaking), any 1 Bugei or Low Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 on Stealth and Hunting rolls; improvised/rural traps deal +1k1 extra damage.
ask: From The Great Clans p.70: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: The source of the Crane's mastery of court. The Doji School builds vast networks of allies through favours and obligations, with a curriculum broad enough to meet any need.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Courtier (Manipulation), Etiquette (Courtesy), Perform: Storytelling, Sincerity, Tea Ceremony, any one Artisan or Perform skill
schools.t1d: Free Raise on Courtier, Sincerity, and Etiquette while Honor is 6.0+; a Contested Roll can learn what favor someone needs.

schools.lore: Crane magistrates trained to fight with compassion, avoiding injury where they can and favouring weapons such as the jitte and sasumata that disarm or capture.
schools.sk: Defense, Horsemanship, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Knives (Jitte), Polearms, any High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Add your Air Ring to Armor TN (unless helpless/unaware); +1k0 attacking with jitte or sasumata.
ask: From Emerald Empire p.170: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: The Kakita Dueling Academy is devoted to iaijutsu above all. Its champions decide battles before they begin and answer any challenge at court.
schools.sk: Etiquette, Iaijutsu (Focus), Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Sincerity, Tea Ceremony, any one Bugei or High Skill
schools.t1d: Add twice your Iaijutsu Skill to Initiative rolls; while in the Center Stance (and the Round after), gain +1k1 plus your School Rank to attack and Focus rolls.

schools.lore: The Kakita Artisan Academy studies every art, performed or crafted, and how each can serve the Crane Clan.
schools.sk: Courtier, Games: Sadane, Etiquette, Sincerity, any 3 skills from Acting/Artisan/Perform
schools.t1d: Choose a 'chosen art' Skill: +2k0 to its rolls, unlimited Raises; Free Raise when critiquing others' art with Games: Sadane.
ask: From The Great Clans p.71: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Alone in the Empire, the Kitsuki believe in evidence. Their School hones near-perfect memory and observation, making them the Dragon's courtiers and natural magistrates.
schools.sk: Courtier, Etiquette (Courtesy), Investigation (Interrogation), Kenjutsu, Meditation, Sincerity, any one Lore Skill
schools.t1d: Free Raise on all Investigation rolls; add your Perception to your Armor TN in a skirmish.

schools.lore: The only School that teaches Niten, fighting with katana and wakizashi together, which fuels a long rivalry with the Kakita's single-sword style.
schools.sk: Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: Shugenja, Meditation, Lore: Theology, any one Bugei or High Skill
schools.t1d: Wielding katana and wakizashi together (Niten) removes dual-wield penalties and adds your School Rank to Armor TN, stacking with the normal two-weapon bonus; you may also raise or lower the TN of a spell cast at you by 5.

schools.lore: Swordsmen who train beside the Togashi tattooed monks and bring their unconventional methods to the blade.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: Theology, Meditation, any 1 Bugei or High Skill
schools.t1d: Wielding a sword while wearing no armor grants Reduction equal to School Rank + 2 and +1k0 to sword damage.
ask: From Emerald Empire p.221: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Formed from the Agasha who stayed with the Dragon, the Tamori inherited their experimental magic, notably sealing a spell's essence in prepared liquids for later use.
schools.sk: Athletics, Calligraphy (Cipher), Defense, Divination, Lore: Theology, Medicine, Spellcraft
schools.t1d: Store a person/creature-targeting spell in a potion by expending a spell slot; anyone can trigger it later by drinking (Simple Action) or throwing it (Complex Action, Athletics/Agility). It still counts against your daily spell slots each day it awaits use, and takes hours equal to the spell's Mastery Level to brew. Also grants a Free Raise on Craft-keyword spells.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: The ise zumi, whose tattoos, inked with the Kami Togashi's blood, grant supernatural powers. Revered and feared, they excel at unarmed combat and feats of athleticism.
schools.sk: Athletics, Artisan: Tattooing, Defense, Jiujutsu, any one Lore Skill, Meditation, any one non-Low Skill
schools.t1d: Gain two Tattoos at this Rank.
know: Tattooed monk: the app does not model tattoos yet.

schools.lore: A branch of the Togashi tattooed monks begun in the Hidden Emperor era, when Togashi Hoshi broke with Hitomi and began tattooing his own followers.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Meditation (Void Recovery), any 2 Skills
schools.t1d: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action to gain, for a number of Rounds equal to your School Rank, either +1k1 to unarmed attack rolls or +1k0 to unarmed damage (chosen each Turn). You begin with 1 Tattoo and 2 known Kiho (prerequisites still apply), can buy further Kiho as a Brotherhood of Shinsei monk, and gain an additional Tattoo at School Rank 4.
ask: From Imperial Histories 1 p.214: check your GM uses this book.
Belongs to one period of Rokugan's history: check it fits your campaign's era.
know: Uses the kiho rules.
Tattooed monk: the app does not model tattoos yet.

schools.lore: Tattooed monks, mostly of the Hitomi family, who seek enlightenment through violent physical action. They flourish under Lady Hitomi but appear in other eras too.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore (choose one), Meditation, any 2 Non-Low Skills
schools.t1d: Gain 1 Tattoo; add Reflexes to Armor TN, and may use Reflexes instead of Strength to control a Grapple.
ask: From Imperial Histories 1 p.215: check your GM uses this book.
Belongs to one period of Rokugan's history: check it fits your campaign's era.
know: Tattooed monk: the app does not model tattoos yet.

schools.lore: The Akodo refuse narrow specialisation: their School perfects precise, fundamental kenjutsu and pairs it with a thorough study of battle.
schools.sk: Battle (Mass Combat), Defense, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: History, Sincerity, any one Bugei or High Skill
schools.t1d: Choose to ignore an opponent's Armor-derived Armor TN, or gain a Free Raise when attacking; also +1k0 on your first melee attack against a foe each skirmish, or against anyone who's Raised on you since your last Turn (capped at +1k0 regardless of how many times).

schools.lore: The Empire's great storytellers. Ikoma bards argue through history and parable, invoking ancestors and heroes to win debates and spread Glory.
schools.sk: Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: History (Lion Clan), Perform: Storytelling, Sincerity (Honesty), any one High Skill, any one Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Gain the Precise Memory Advantage free; publicly praising someone's heroic deeds via a successful Perform: Storytelling/Awareness roll (TN 20) grants them Glory equal to your School Rank, usable per person per month up to your School Rank times.

schools.lore: A small, secretive School that keeps alive the ruthless, pragmatic methods of the first Ikoma, which the family's histories prefer to forget.
schools.sk: Courtier, Etiquette, Kenjutsu, Investigation (Notice), Sincerity, Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill
schools.t1d: No Honor loss for Low Skills used for the Lion Clan's benefit; as a Free Action, target a number of foes equal to School Rank for +1k0 on attack and Contested Rolls against them, usable School Rank times per day, lasting the rest of the day.
ask: From Emerald Empire p.109: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Keeping rituals unchanged since the family began, the Kitsu sense and work the bonds between the living, their ancestors and other realms, and command large-scale battle magic.
schools.sk: Battle, Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Roll a Spell Casting Roll (as a Water spell) vs. the target's Willpower x5 to learn all their Spiritual Advantages/Disadvantages; spend a Void Point to suppress one Spiritual Advantage of theirs for minutes equal to School Rank. Also grants a Free Raise on Battle-keyword spells.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: The Lion's spear units are few in modern times and other Clans see them as a relic of an earlier age. Several escort the new Miya Governor of Naishou Province.
schools.sk: Battle, Defense, Kenjutsu, Lore: History, Polearms, Spears (Magari-Yari), any one Bugei or High Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 on Spear and Polearm Skill rolls; in Center, Defense, or Full Defense Stance with a spear/polearm, gain Reduction equal to half your Skill Rank.
ask: From Naishou Province p.7: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Matsu who take lion warcats into their own pride and communicate with them almost mystically, though the bond can leave them awkward among people.
schools.sk: Animal Handling 2, Battle, Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu, any 1 Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Gain a bonded lion warcat that follows commands and won't attack you; direct it to Attack (Complex Action) or it defaults to Guard.
ask: From The Great Clans p.136: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Most Matsu train here. The School teaches total, fearless commitment to the attack, on the principle that a beaten foe cannot strike back.
schools.sk: Battle, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: History, any two Bugei Skills
schools.t1d: Add your Honor Rank to all damage rolls; Full Attack Stance grants an extra 5' of movement (within your normal max).

schools.lore: Agasha shugenja pursue unconventional magic, from alchemy to spells that call on several elements at once, and the Phoenix let them take that study as far as it leads.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), any one Craft Skill, Defense, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Spend a Void Point to cast a spell using a different Ring than the one it normally requires (still uses a spell slot of the Ring actually used). Also grants a Free Raise on Craft-keyword spells.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: A secretive monastic sect of the Asako whose ways few outside the family understand. Its monks study how a person relates to the Elements that make up all things.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Jiujutsu, Lore: Elements, Lore: Theology, Meditation 2, any 1 Skill (not Low)
schools.t1d: As a Simple Action, raise or lower both Traits tied to one of your Rings by your School Rank (half, rounded down, minimum 1, if targeting someone else — and a Contested Willpower Roll if they're unwilling/unaware). Lasts minutes equal to your Insight Rank, usable up to 5x Insight Rank times per day. Doesn't change the underlying Ring or Wound Ranks.
ask: From The Great Clans p.199: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Scholarly Asako courtiers who study an unusually wide range of subjects and turn that learning into insight and influence at court.
schools.sk: Courtier, Etiquette (Courtesy), Lore: History, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, Sincerity, any Lore Skill
schools.t1d: Free Raise on any Lore Skill Roll; spending a Void Point on Etiquette grants +3k1 instead of the usual +1k1.

schools.lore: The oldest shugenja School in Rokugan and the largest shugenja family. The Isawa have pursued the secrets of the universe for more than a thousand years.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), Lore: Theology, any one Lore Skill, Medicine, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High Skill
schools.t1d: Free Raise on all Spell Casting Rolls of your Affinity element.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: A quiet Shiba tradition that seeks to capture beauty as purely as possible; unlike the Kakita, a Shiba artist needs no audience.
schools.sk: Artisan (pick 2), Calligraphy, Etiquette, Lore (pick 1), Sincerity, any 1 High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Choose one Artisan Skill; spending a Void Point on it grants +2k2 instead of the usual +1k1.
ask: From Emerald Empire p.122: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Warrior-scholars who look for any alternative to bloodshed, then strike swiftly when it comes. Their Techniques draw on the Void and protect others, suiting them to yojimbo work.
schools.sk: Defense, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Meditation (Void Recovery), Spears, Lore: Theology, any one Bugei or High Skill
schools.t1d: Spending a Void Point for +1k1 can instead be upgraded to spending 2 Void Points for +2k2; Guard as a Free Action, though the target's Armor TN bonus drops to +5 instead of +10.

schools.lore: The School behind the Scorpion's villainous reputation trains its students as agents of discord, adding manipulation, stealth and even poison to their swordplay. Its Techniques are dirty tricks that exploit every advantage.
schools.sk: Courtier (Manipulation), Defense, Etiquette, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu, Sincerity, any one Skill
schools.t1d: +1k1 to Initiative Rolls; +5 Armor TN against any opponent with lower Initiative than you.
know: Starts with low Honor (2.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Masters of manipulation whose patient gathering of secrets built the Scorpion's network of informants. They find the weakness in any opponent, or ally, and use it for the Clan.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Courtier (Gossip), Etiquette, Investigation, Sincerity (Deceit), Temptation, any one High skill
schools.t1d: In a Contested Social Roll, gain a Free Raise for every 3 points of Mental/Social Disadvantages your opponent has (max 5 Free Raises). Also, Free Raise on Courtier when spreading gossip, without needing a Raise to hide that you're the source.
know: Starts with low Honor (2.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Shinobi who infiltrate in plain sight, disguised as servants, peasants or even particular samurai, which is why the Shosuro have long practised acting.
schools.sk: Acting, Etiquette, Knives, Meditation, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill
schools.t1d: Learn one persona; spending a Void Point on Acting or Sincerity (Deceit) grants +3k1 instead of the usual +1k1.
ask: From The Great Clans p.227: check your GM uses this book.
Ninja: a secret even within their own Clan, and exposure means disgrace or death. Your GM will need to plan around it.
know: Starts with low Honor (1.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: A School few outsiders know exists, training silent killers who strike unsuspecting targets from hiding, without pleasure or remorse.
schools.sk: Acting, Athletics, Ninjutsu, Sincerity, Stealth (Sneaking) 2, any one Skill
schools.t1d: No Honor loss for Low Skills or Ninjutsu weapons used for the Scorpion Clan; +2k0 to all Stealth Skill rolls.
ask: Ninja: a secret even within their own Clan, and exposure means disgrace or death. Your GM will need to plan around it.
know: Starts with low Honor (1.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Grown from techniques taught to the yoriki of Soshi Saibankan, this School trains the Scorpion's magistrates and guards in both armed and unarmed fighting.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Intimidation (Control), Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Underworld, any Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 to Intimidation (+2k0 vs. someone of lower Status); +1k0 damage on melee attacks.
ask: From Emerald Empire p.171: check your GM uses this book.
know: Starts with low Honor (2.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Called in when stealth and subtlety are needed, Soshi shugenja coax the amoral kami into trickery and can cast most non-damaging spells without any visible sign.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, Stealth, any 1 Skill
schools.t1d: Sacrifice an extra spell slot of the same Element when casting a non-damaging spell to hide all visible signs it was cast; also grants a Free Raise on Illusion-keyword spells.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.
Starts with low Honor (2.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Shugenja of the Yogo's closely guarded ward magic: protective charms more flexible than the Toritaka's exorcism wards.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Investigation, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill
schools.t1d: Cast a Wards-keyword spell with extra Raises (equal to its Mastery Level) to store it latent in a paper ward; activate it later as a Simple Action by placing it on a target (an unwilling target requires a Spellcraft/Agility attack roll). Destroying an active ward ends its effect; the spell slot isn't freed until the ward discharges or is destroyed unused.
ask: From The Great Clans p.229: check your GM uses this book.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.
Starts with low Honor (1.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Keepers of meishodo, the talisman magic the Unicorn gathered from many peoples on their travels beyond the Empire. In earlier eras the Iuchi teach it.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Craft: Meishodo, Defense, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft (Spell Research), any 1 High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Craft magical amulets: roll Craft: Meishodo/Ring for the spell's Ring (TN 15 + 5x Mastery Level, taking hours equal to the Mastery Level) to store one spell in a charm. Casting from it takes one Complex Action with no Spell Casting Roll needed (and no Raise benefits), still using a spell slot. Only spells of Mastery Level up to your School Rank (never 4-6) can be stored this way, and anyone trained in meishodo can use your amulets.
ask: From The Great Clans p.257: check your GM uses this book.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: The most peaceable courtiers of the Great Clans, the Ide cultivate calm and mediation. Their Techniques never attack; they defuse conflict and protect the Emissary.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Commerce, Courtier, Etiquette (Conversation), Horsemanship, Sincerity (Honesty), any one High or Perform skill
schools.t1d: Roll Etiquette (Courtesy)/Awareness (TN 20) to avoid inadvertently giving offense; Free Raise on Sincerity (Honesty), but Sincerity (Deceit) rolls get +5 TN instead.

schools.lore: Free-spirited and unconventional, the Iuchi learned much of their craft on the open plains during the Unicorn's wanderings, meishodo talismans included. Their magic favours speed and travel.
schools.sk: Battle, Calligraphy (Cipher), Horsemanship, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: As a Complex Action, sacrifice a spell slot of any element to grant a target an extra Simple Move Action on their next Turn (lost if unused). Also grants a Free Raise on Travel-keyword spells.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: Descended in part from the nomads who joined the Unicorn abroad, the Moto fight as unrestrained heavy cavalry, a style other Clans find both fearsome and improper.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Horsemanship, Hunting, Kenjutsu (Scimitar), any one Bugei Skill, any one Skill
schools.t1d: Wield any two-handed weapon (except bows) in one hand; +1k0 damage while mounted, using a scimitar, or using a two-handed melee weapon (these don't stack); scimitars count as having the Samurai keyword for you.

schools.lore: Followers of the Shi-Tien Yen-Wang, a wrathful pantheon of foreign death gods, who turn those gods' disfavour on their enemies.
schools.sk: Athletics, Horsemanship, Hunting, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any 1 Skill
schools.t1d: As a Simple Action, sacrifice a spell slot to target an enemy within School Rank x100 feet with a Contested Willpower Roll; on success they can't benefit from exploding dice or re-roll Advantages for Rounds equal to your School Rank. Also grants a Free Raise on Travel-keyword spells.
ask: From Imperial Histories 1 p.240: check your GM uses this book.
Belongs to one period of Rokugan's history: check it fits your campaign's era.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: Born of the shame of Moto Tsume's fall into the Shadowlands, the Vindicators swore to destroy the Tainted Moto and every Shadowlands creature.
schools.sk: Horsemanship, Hunting, Investigation (Notice), Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any 1 Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Each Round, choose either to reduce Wound Rank TN penalties, or add to your Armor TN, by School Rank + Willpower (doubled against Shadowlands creatures).
ask: From The Great Clans p.258: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Mounted fighters whose style adopts foreign methods from the Unicorn's travels, such as the active parry and riposte, unfamiliar to most Rokugani.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Horsemanship 2, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, any 1 Skill
schools.t1d: When spending a Void Point for +1k1 on a School Skill Roll, also add your Horsemanship Rank to the total (not usable in Center Stance).
ask: From Emerald Empire p.31: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: The shiotome, the most respected cavalry in the Empire and the only riders allowed to breed the Utaku steeds. Honor strengthens their mounted Techniques.
schools.sk: Battle, Defense, Horsemanship 2, Kenjutsu, Sincerity, any one High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Add your Honor Rank to one attack roll per Round (or a damage roll instead, while mounted); +Honor Rank to all Horsemanship rolls.

schools.lore: Soldiers who ride to battle and fight on foot, developed during the Unicorn's wanderings; many are Otaku men barred by tradition from fighting on horseback.
schools.sk: Athletics, Battle, Defense, Kenjutsu, Polearms, Spears, any one Bugei or High Skill
schools.t1d: Choose Kenjutsu, Polearms, or Spears; gain a free Emphasis in it and +1k0 to attack rolls with it. In Defense/Full Defense Stance with that weapon, add full Skill Rank to Armor TN (Spears/Polearms) or half Skill Rank rounded down (Kenjutsu).

schools.lore: Heirs of the destroyed Snake Clan, the Chuda keep a secret tradition of maho centuries old and now serve the Spider, always pushing blood magic further whatever it costs.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), Hunting, Lore: Maho, Lore: Shadowlands, Spellcraft, Stealth, any one Skill
schools.t1d: Declare a Raise when casting maho to hide its corrupted nature; a second Raise (or 1 Honor) caps the Taint gained from that spell at 1 point.

schools.lore: Spider Clan warriors whose style is pieced together from the Schools they knew in their former lives. Eclectic but brutal, it can even feed on a dying foe's life force.
schools.sk: Hunting, Intimidation, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei or Low Skill
schools.t1d: Each Round, choose to reduce Wound-Rank TN penalties or increase damage rolls by Strength + Taint Rank; detecting your Taint is also harder (TN +10).

know: Starts with low Honor (1.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Spider courtiers who slip into the courts of the Great Clans in disguise, using blackmail and contacts to steer rivals into conflict while hiding their own Taint.
schools.sk: Acting, Courtier (Manipulation), Etiquette, Meditation, Sincerity (Deceit), Temptation, any one High Skill
schools.t1d: Free Raise on Sincerity (Deceit); Taint-detection TN vs. you rises with your School Rank, and your School Rank adds to your effective Honor when others judge it.
ask: Spider Clan: tied to the Shadowlands and often Tainted. Usually changes the whole campaign, so agree it with your GM and the other players first.
know: Starts with low Honor (1): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.sk: Athletics, Kenjutsu, Ninjutsu, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth 2, any one Skill
schools.t1d: Simple Action to raise Armor TN by up to School Rank x5, at the cost of the same penalty to most other rolls, for the skirmish.

schools.lore: Called shugenja only for convenience, the Ninube are no longer truly individuals; their power, like the Goju's, comes from the Nothing.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Knives, Sincerity (Lying), Spellcraft, Stealth 2, any Low skill
schools.t1d: Expend a spell slot to become an invisible-in-darkness shadow with a Stealth bonus, immune to most mundane harm; returning to physical form after lethal damage leaves you Stunned but alive.

schools.n: The Order of the Spider Monks [Monk]
schools.lore: Begun with the fallen monk Roshungi and spread by his student Michio, the Order teaches each follower to find their own path whatever it costs others.
schools.sk: Athletics, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Polearms, any one Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 to unarmed/polearm attack rolls, and add twice your School Rank to Armor TN against melee attacks.
ask: Spider Clan: tied to the Shadowlands and often Tainted. Usually changes the whole campaign, so agree it with your GM and the other players first.
know: Starts with low Honor (1.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: Imperial messengers who carry the Emperor's word to every corner of Rokugan. They build trust, calm disputes and can defend themselves on dangerous roads.
schools.sk: Courtier (Rhetoric), Defense, Etiquette (Courtesy), Horsemanship, Lore: Heraldry, Sincerity, any 1 High or Bugei skill
schools.t1d: Spend a Void Point for the Way of the Land Advantage in your current province until you next sleep; attackers who revere the Emperor lose Honor equal to twice your School Rank.
know: Serves the Imperial families rather than a Great Clan.

schools.lore: Imperial courtiers who protect the throne by sowing suspicion among the Great Clans. They trade on Imperial authority and use every underhanded trick, safe behind their bloodline.
schools.sk: Courtier (Manipulation), Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation (Control), Investigation, Sincerity, any 1 High Skill
schools.t1d: No Honor loss for Intimidation (Control); a Contested Roll can provoke an argument between two other people.
know: Serves the Imperial families rather than a Great Clan.

schools.lore: The Miharu, who give up everything to guard the Imperial House. Their School puts defence, and the life of the one they protect, above the guardsman's own.
schools.sk: Battle, Defense, Etiquette, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, any 1 High Skill
schools.t1d: Extra unkept dice equal to School Rank resisting Temptation/Intimidation/Courtier meant to pull you from duty; +1k1 to Investigation rolls detecting ambushes.
know: Serves the Imperial families rather than a Great Clan.

schools.lore: The Hidden Guard: shugenja who keep constant watch against threats steel cannot answer, with some of the finest wards in Rokugan, as the Emperor's last line of defence.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Defense, Etiquette, Investigation (Notice), Meditation, Lore: Theology, any 1 High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Free Raise on spells protecting the Emperor or Imperial family (when it wouldn't cost Honor), and on spells known only to Imperial families.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.
Serves the Imperial families rather than a Great Clan.

schools.lore: Founded by a Hida, the Badger's School stays close to its Crab roots: wrestling, unarmed fighting and sheer strength that answers finesse with overwhelming force.
schools.sk: Athletics, Commerce, Defense, Heavy Weapons, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), any High or Bugei skill
schools.t1d: You may re-roll any Skill or Trait roll that uses Strength, but the second result stands. Moderate terrain costs you nothing on movement or combat, and Difficult terrain only half its usual penalty. (Core Rulebook p.216)
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: The Bat Clan's shugenja draw on the koumori, kindly bat spirits of Chikushudo, for strange spells and swift messages across the Empire.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), Lore: Ancestors, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, Tea Ceremony, any one High Skill
schools.t1d: Spend one spell slot to whisper a message to someone you know: up to thirty seconds long per School Rank, carried up to 100 miles per School Rank. (Core Rulebook p.217)
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.
A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Shaped by the dangers of the Boar lands, Heichi bushi take the enemy's worst and keep fighting. The School favours the rare curved Mai Chong spear and a patient, defensive style.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Intimidation, Kenjutsu, Spears (Mai Chong), any one Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: While in the Full Attack Stance, readying a Medium weapon or a spear is a Free Action for you, and a spear you fight with gains +0k1 damage. (Core Rulebook p.218)
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Deeply spiritual priests of the mountains who also serve as go-betweens for the Dragon at court, using their bond with the spirits to sharpen their social graces.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Courtier, Etiquette, Meditation (Void Recovery), Sincerity, Spellcraft, any one High Skill
schools.t1d: Spend a spell slot for +1k0 on a Social Skill Roll, never more slots on one roll than your School Rank. Free Raise on spells with the Divination keyword. (Core Rulebook p.218)
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.
A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Specialists in destroying creatures from other spirit realms, with a fluid style for unexpected monsters: potent against the otherworldly, less so against people.
schools.sk: Animal Handling (Falcons), Hunting 2, Kenjutsu, Etiquette, Lore: Spirit Realms, Spears, any one Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 on Perception-based Skill and Trait rolls, and +1k0 to damage against creatures from other Spirit Realms.
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Living beside one of Rokugan's great forests, Fox shugenja learn to love its spirits and creatures, and their School deepens the bond between people and animals.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Defense, Hunting, Medicine (Herbalism), Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei skill
schools.t1d: Your Sense, Commune and Summon can reach Chikushudo’s animal spirits, not only the kami (Summon then brings one animal spirit rather than an amount of an element). Free Raise on any spell cast on an animal that does no damage. (Core Rulebook p.220)
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.
A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Tested by centuries of war, the Hare's School turns their athleticism into hit-and-run attacks that seem to come from every side.
schools.sk: Athletics (Running), Defense, Hunting, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Maho, any one High or Bugei skill
schools.t1d: Where there is room to dodge and leap (the GM decides), add your Athletics Rank to your Armor TN, except in the Full Attack or Center Stance. For the distance of Move Actions your Water counts as 1 higher. (Core Rulebook p.221)
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Born of shipboard fights and tavern brawls among the Mantis Clan's pirates and smugglers, a fighting style even less conventional than the Yoritomo's.
schools.sk: Athletics, Commerce, Intimidation, Jiujutsu, Knives, Sailing, any 1 Weapon Skill
schools.t1d: Being Prone costs you nothing on Armor TN, or on attacks with Small weapons or unarmed, and against ranged attacks you still get the usual Prone bonus to Armor TN. +1k0 on rolls to take control of a Grapple, and on damage dealt unarmed or with an improvised or Small weapon. (The Great Clans p.166)
ask: From The Great Clans p.165: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Long devoted to the Sun Goddess, the Moshi turned to practical weather magic after joining the Mantis and often sail on Yoritomo ships to calm the seas.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), Divination, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any two High or Bugei Skills
schools.t1d: By day you have a second Affinity, for Fire spells; it lapses at night. Free Raise on spells with the Thunder keyword. (Core Rulebook p.121)
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: The Empire's finest archers since their days as the Wasp Clan, devoted to the purity of the bow: deadly at range, outclassed in melee.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Investigation, Kyujutsu (Yumi) 2, any one Bugei or High Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 to the total of your attack rolls with a bow, and +3 to your Initiative Score. (Core Rulebook p.122)

schools.lore: The Wasp Clan once lived by hunting fugitives for the Emerald Champion; a few Tsuruchi still learn that relentless trade as a School of its own.
schools.sk: Athletics, Hunting (Tracking), Intimidation, Investigation, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Underworld
schools.t1d: +1k1 on Intimidation against someone of lower caste you think can lead you to your quarry; with samurai the bonus falls to +1k0 but covers every Social Skill Roll. While hunting a particular target, roll extra unkept dice, as many as your School Rank, on Hunting or Investigation rolls to track it down. (The Great Clans p.168)
ask: From The Great Clans p.167: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Fighters shaped by ship-to-ship combat, with fluid movement, a habit of exploiting weaknesses quickly and skill with peasant weapons that stand up to sea air.
schools.sk: Commerce, Defense, Jiujutsu (Improved Weapons), Kenjutsu, Knives (Kama), Sailing, any one Skill
schools.t1d: Rough or uneven ground costs you nothing on movement or attacks. Fighting with improvised or Peasant-keyword weapons loses you no Honor or Glory, and a Small or Medium Peasant weapon carries no off-hand penalty. +1k0 to all attack rolls. (Core Rulebook p.120)

schools.lore: Created to serve the Mantis's trade, these courtiers rely on intimidation and bullying, a style that has found more success since the Mantis became a Great Clan.
schools.sk: Commerce (Appraisal), Courtier, Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation (Control), Sincerity, any one Merchant or Lore skill
schools.t1d: Using Commerce in public costs you no Honor or Glory, and Intimidation (Control) costs no Honor. Social Skill Rolls against ronin, bandits, gangsters, mercenaries, pirates and other outlaws gain Free Raises equal to your School Rank. (Core Rulebook p.121)
know: Starts with low Honor (2.5): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: A small Yoritomo line, begun with a daughter of the Mantis founder, with an unmatched bond to the spirits of the sea and storm.
schools.sk: Athletics, Calligraphy, Knives, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Sailing (Navigation), any 1 Skill
schools.t1d: Spend a spell slot to shift the wind where you are by one degree, or a slot and a Void Point to shift the whole weather by one degree; no more slots and Void Points together each Round than your School Rank. The change reaches miles equal to your School Rank around you. Free Raise on Thunder spells. (The Great Clans p.169)
ask: From The Great Clans p.168: check your GM uses this book.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: The Monkey Clan's School teaches calm against overwhelming odds and fighting many foes at once.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Investigation (Search), Kenjutsu, Lore: History, any 1 High or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: +1k0 on any Skill Roll, attacks included, against a TN of 25 or more. Your Wound penalties are reduced by your Willpower plus twice your School Rank. (Core Rulebook p.222)
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Begun as ronin shugenja in Toturi's Army under Yasuki Garou, a friend of Toku, the Fuzake swore to the Monkey Clan and devote themselves to healing and an eccentric reverence for the Fortunes.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Defense, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Medicine, Spellcraft, any one High or Merchant Skill
schools.t1d: When you cast a healing spell (one that mends Wounds, or cures poison or disease, Path to Inner Peace and Peace of the Kami among them), you may also spend Earth spell slots; each one gives a Free Raise on the Spell Casting Roll. (Secrets of the Empire p.238)
ask: From Secrets of the Empire p.238: check your GM uses this book.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.

schools.lore: Named for a foreign smith honoured by the second Emperor and revived by a ronin centuries later, the School forges weapons and armour and learns to fight so it knows how they are used.
schools.sk: Any one Artisan Skill, Commerce, two ranks in any one Craft Skill, Defense, any one Weapon Skill, any one High, Bugei, or Merchant Skill
schools.t1d: Every Craft Skill counts as a School Skill for effects that care. A successful Craft roll against a TN of at least 10 plus 5 per School Rank earns 1 point of Glory, and 1 more for each 5 by which you beat the TN. (Core Rulebook p.223)
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: The Ox Clan's heavy cavalry, trained to ride down infantry and make the most of a horse's speed; most fight with a polearm.
schools.sk: Defense, Horsemanship, Hunting (Tracking), Kenjutsu, Lore: Kolat, Lore: Underworld, any one Skill
schools.t1d: While Mounted you gain +1k0 to Initiative at the start of combat and +1k0 to attack rolls. (Core Rulebook p.224)
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: The Snake Clan's original School, founded by an Imperial magistrate sworn to destroy maho-tsukai. Its shugenja hunted Tainted sorcerers and their monsters with Earth and Jade magic.
schools.sk: Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: Maho, Lore: Shadowlands, Spellcraft, any 2 Skills
schools.t1d: For a Void Point (a Free Action), lower one target’s Reduction by your School Rank. Your spells’ damage rolls gain your School Rank against a target with the Shadowlands Taint. (Core Rulebook p.224)
ask: Belongs to one period of Rokugan's history: check it fits your campaign's era.
know: Casts spells: you will choose starting spells and track spell slots.
A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Founded from Crane samurai, the Sparrow keep a katana style that waits for the perfect strike, and their love of stories helps them read the flow of battle.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Perform: Storytelling, any one Lore Skill, any one Skill
schools.t1d: At the start of a Round, before anyone acts, you may lower your Initiative Score by 5 for +1k0 on every attack and damage roll that Round. (Core Rulebook p.225)
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Tortoise agents who move among the Empire's criminals, ruthless and steeped in the underworld, finding allies wherever they can, even among honest peasants.
schools.sk: Commerce, Etiquette, Investigation (Notice), Lore: Underworld, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth, any one High, Merchant, or Low Skill
schools.t1d: At character creation each purchase of the Languages Advantage also brings one gaijin language free. While serving your clan you lose no Honor for Low Skills and no Glory for using Commerce in public. +2k0 on all Social Skill Rolls with heimin and hinin (peasants, merchants, eta). (Core Rulebook p.227)
know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.
Starts with low Honor (2): other samurai may distrust them.

schools.lore: From the ronin family that guarded the commoners of Otosan Uchi, the School grew into a full bushi style while fighting the Spider in the capital's ruins. In the Heroes of Rokugan timeline the Yotsu become the Tiger Clan.
schools.sk: Commerce, Hunting, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, any one Skill from Lore: Gaijin or Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth (Sneaking), any one Low or Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: Against enemies of the Empire, halve Honor losses from the Ambush and Shadowing uses of Stealth, rounding down. In urban areas, including ruins, gain +1k0 to Stealth and add Stealth Rank to Armor TN. (Imperial Histories 1 p.276; Tiger Clan in the Heroes of Rokugan alternate timeline)
ask: From Imperial Histories 1 p.276: check your GM uses this book.

know: A Minor Clan: your character may be the only one of their Clan in the story.

schools.lore: Monks who believe enlightenment requires staying engaged with society. With a great monastery in the Imperial capital, they advise lords and help travellers.
schools.sk: Courtier, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Meditation, any two Skills
schools.t1d: When you spend a Void Point to augment a High Skill Roll or a Social Skill Roll, you gain +2k2 instead of the normal +1k1.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: A little-known sect that believes anyone can become a hero. It quietly finds threats to the Empire and the people able to meet them.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (pick an Emphasis), Meditation, any two Skills
schools.t1d: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action to give one ally who has not yet taken his Turn +1k1 on any one roll this Round. Never a roll that cannot normally benefit from Void Points, such as a damage roll.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.n: The Shrine of the Seven Thunders [Monk]
schools.lore: Monks who honour the seven heroes who defeated Fu Leng by devoting their lives to contemplation, rarely leaving their monastery.
schools.sk: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Lore (pick one), Meditation, any two Skills
schools.t1d: All three of your starting Kiho must be chosen from a single Element, and your Insight Rank counts as one higher for meeting the Mastery Level of Kiho from that Element.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: Followers of the Mantis founder who believe he left to avoid a ruinous fight over the Crab's leadership; they seek enlightenment through conciliation and peace.
schools.sk: Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, any three Skills
schools.t1d: In a Contested Social Skill Roll your opponent initiated, you may use any Ring in place of the Trait normally used (typically Awareness).
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: Perhaps the most militant Brotherhood sect, devoted to physical prowess and martial arts; its monks ritually scar themselves to mark their progress.
schools.sk: Battle, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, any two Bugei Skills
schools.t1d: Gain +0k1 to all damage rolls from unarmed attacks, cumulative with any other effect that lets you roll or keep extra dice on unarmed damage.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.n: The Temples of the Thousand Fortunes [Monk]
schools.lore: A varied network of temples to Rokugan's countless Fortunes, whose monks mostly believe they must work hard to prove worthy of enlightenment.
schools.sk: Jiujutsu, Lore: History, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), any one Lore Skill, Meditation, any two Skills
schools.t1d: You begin play knowing four Kiho rather than the usual three. These four do not count against the additional Kiho you may purchase with Experience Points.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: Brothers who accept that the world is chaotic and unpredictable and stay steady within it, gaining command of themselves and, quietly, a little of the world around them.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Staves, any one Skill
schools.t1d: Any effect that targets you and tries to influence your behaviour — spell, courtier Technique, Social Skill, Advantage or anything else — costs its user an additional Void Point to take effect, and that extra point may bypass the normal one-per-Round limit on enhancement effects.
ask: From Book of Air p.193: check your GM uses this book.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: Formed after the Clan War for monks who could not regain their peace after defending the temples. Archery gave them focus, and the order keeps ties to the Asahina and other archery traditions.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Jiujutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Meditation, any two Skills
schools.t1d: Make an archery attack as a Complex Action, gaining +1k0 for each Kiho you currently have active (only one Martial Kiho counts, and active Kiho may have no other effect that Round). If the attack directly kills an intelligent being you lose 3 points of Honor.
ask: From Book of Air p.194: check your GM uses this book.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: A hereditary order of a few bloodlines descended from a tribe older than the Kami's arrival, valued by the Crab for uncannily accurate judgement and prediction.
schools.sk: Calligraphy, Divination, Etiquette, Investigation, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, any one non-Bugei Skill
schools.t1d: You cannot be surprised by an ambush. Before Initiative is rolled you may spend a Void Point and roll Perception at TN 20 to raise your Initiative Score by 20 — a bonus lost the instant you make any attack.
ask: From Book of Air p.194: check your GM uses this book.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.n: The Order of the Nameless Gift [Monk]
schools.lore: An offshoot of the Shrine of the Seven Thunders that seeks the Thunders' fate-changing power in every soul through physical rigour and trials of endurance, taking the world plainly as it is.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore (pick one), Meditation, any two Skills
schools.t1d: You gain Void Points per day equal to your Earth Ring, spendable only to reduce damage or to raise your Armor TN, never simultaneously with other Void Points or in any other way. This sheet does not track that separate pool for you.
ask: From Book of Earth p.205: check your GM uses this book.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: A largely martial order devoted to unyielding endurance. Its training tests body, mind and spirit to their limits, and its stubborn monks rarely accept defeat.
schools.sk: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu (Martial Arts), Lore: Theology, Meditation, any one Bugei Skill, any one Skill
schools.t1d: Spend a Void Point as a Free Action to ignore all penalties to the very next roll. If that roll is an Attack Roll, or a Contested Roll you did not initiate, also add +Xk0 where X is your Earth Ring.
ask: From Book of Earth p.205: check your GM uses this book.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: Descended from militant sohei of Osano-Wo, these brothers embrace new paths and philosophies to uncover new truths, earning other sects' disdain.
schools.sk: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Meditation, any two Skills
schools.t1d: Each time in an encounter that you activate a Kiho of a different Element from every Kiho already used that encounter, you gain +5 on the activation roll.
ask: From Book of Fire p.190: check your GM uses this book.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: A friendly offshoot of the Shrine of the Seven Thunders, these sohei see violence as a natural part of life: never a first resort, but an option they use exceptionally well.
schools.sk: Athletics, Battle, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology, Meditation, any one Skill
schools.t1d: When attacking unarmed, or with a bisento, a bo staff, or any weapon with the Monk property, gain a Free Raise on the attack roll if your Fire Ring exceeds your opponent’s.
ask: From Book of Fire p.191: check your GM uses this book.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: Perhaps the oldest monastic tradition in Crane lands. Its ancient temple helped the Lady Doji spread culture and won its monks unusual prestige.
schools.sk: Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Sincerity, any one High Skill
schools.t1d: On any Social Skill Roll, name one Kiho you know: you may not use it for the rest of the day, but you gain +1k1 on the roll. Each Kiho may be spent this way only once per day.
ask: From Book of Fire p.191: check your GM uses this book.
know: Uses the kiho rules.

schools.lore: Founded during the Great Famine to tend the sick of every caste; some members also treat injuries and, in later centuries, madness.
schools.sk: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: Anatomy (Disease), Medicine (Disease, Herbalism), Meditation, Staves, any one Skill
schools.t1d: +1k1 on Medicine rolls to treat disease or infection and +1k0 to treat Wounds. You may also attempt to treat natural, non-Taint insanity with a Medicine roll, though whether it helps is your GM’s call.
ask: From Book of Water p.187: check your GM uses this book.

schools.lore: Ascetics who seek trance states, through sleeplessness, drink, wild dance and visionary plants, to receive guidance from the Fortunes and spirits, above all through omens.
schools.sk: Athletics, Divination (Omens), Jiujutsu, Lore: Omens, Meditation, any two Skills
schools.t1d: +1k0 on all Divination rolls, or +1k1 when interpreting an omen. Once per day you may spend a Void Point to interpret an omen with absolute accuracy and no roll — though what the omen truly means remains your GM’s call.

schools.lore: Monks who study the nature of time and wait for the right moment to act. Their long stillness and sudden action can make them seem odd, even mad.
schools.sk: Defense, Divination (Astrology), Jiujutsu, Meditation, Lore: Theology, any two High Skills
schools.t1d: Contemplate a non-combat situation for as long as your GM requires, then roll Meditation / Void at TN 25 or higher. On a success gain +1k1 +Void on Skill Rolls made to resolve that specific situation, for no more rolls than your Void Rank before further contemplation is needed.

magic.q: Do you want your character to cast spells?
a: Yes: magic is the heart of who they are
A touch of the mystical, but no spells
No: they rely on their own skill

complexity.q: How much rules detail do you want to keep track of?
a: Keep it simple: I am still learning the game
Lots of moving parts: I like mastering a system

niche.q: How do you feel about unusual characters?
a: A classic samurai most players will recognise
Open to something a bit different

approach.q: When trouble starts, what does your character reach for first?
a: Words: persuasion, wit or a well-placed secret
Inner discipline and their own two hands
The shadows: they would rather not be seen

fight.q: In a fight, where do you want to be?
a: In the front line, taking hits and hitting back harder
Facing one opponent: a single perfect strike
At a distance, with a bow
Fast and mobile: strike and get away

court.q: Away from a fight, how do they get their way?
a: Secrets, leverage and a little fear
Evidence: they find out the truth

magickind.q: What should their magic be best at?
a: Speaking with spirits, ancestors and the dead
Water: adaptable, healing and always moving
Void: the rare, mystical space between

ambition.q: What would they most like to be remembered for?
a: Standing between the Empire and the darkness
Perfect mastery of an art: the sword, the brush or the stage
Victory: battles won and enemies broken
Wisdom: understanding the secrets of the world
Loyalty in the shadows: doing what others will not
Freedom: going where no one else has been

home.q: Where do they feel most at home?
a: On a great wall, facing a monster-haunted wasteland
At sea, among islands and ports
On the road, never in one place for long

rules.q: Would they break the rules to get the job done?
a: Never: their word and their honour are everything
Only if there is truly no other way
Yes, if the result is worth it

bushido.q: Which virtue of Bushido matters most to them?
a: None of them: results matter more
Deeply: prayer and meditation shape their life
Not very: steel and results matter more

companion.q: Who or what would you like at their side?
a: A hunting falcon or a war-cat
A fine blade, their family's pride

death.q: Every samurai thinks about how they will die. How will yours?
a: In a last stand, holding the line
Fighting the darkness, far from home
Of old age, surrounded by students
Quietly, with secrets no one ever learns
At the head of an army
Somewhere no one from home has ever been
